messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up from morning incident. Need concrete owners for postmortem actions and which evals to add.
Tom: OK what are you thinking?
Maria: Priorities: 1) small regression prompt set for fallback/chat path, 2) burst load test that mirrors the spike, 3) KV-cache eviction chaos drill, 4) CI light eval pre-deploy (warn first).
Linda: Share sample prompts and I'll start a regression suite.
Maria: Scrubbed prompts: 
```
1) "Summarize this long ticket and extract action items: <redacted>"
2) "From conversation history, produce a concise follow-up with bullets."
3) "Re-rank these results for intent X and state the top reason."
```
Tom: I'll add a k6 scenario: ~200 concurrent for 60s, staggered sequences with mid-sequence long gens.
Kevin: For KV eviction, I'll create a chaos job that forces aggressive TTL and measure p99; add alert if p99 >30% over baseline.
Maria: Proposed owners/timelines: Linda -> regression + CI job (5 business days), Tom -> load test + replay runbook (7 days), Kevin -> chaos drill + dashboard (14 days), Maria -> add gating notes to release checklist (3 days).
Linda: I'll open a PR under eng-ml/evals/regressions/incident-1768 and tag evals:nonblocking.
Tom: I'll include a replay/ folder with exact command and a docker invoker to reproduce locally.
Kevin: I'll extract a scrubbed long-history trace to include in the regression set.
Maria: Decision on CI: start warn-only. After 2 clean runs flip to blocking.
Linda: Agreed. I'll post results to the evals dashboard and link this thread.
Ops Bot: Reminder: create tracking tickets and add label incident-1768123456.
Maria: Created JIRA INC-3247 (tracking) and EVAL-889 (regression). PRs: https://git.redwood.co/r/1345, https://git.redwood.co/r/1346.
Cara: Quick UX note: prompt #2 might be noisy; tighten instructions. I'll comment on the PR once it's up.
Maria: Thanks everyone. Expect initial PRs by EOD and a status update in #eng-ml on Friday.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Linda: On it :rocket:
